fields.title: Your Socioeconomic Certification Unlocks Prime Contract Flow.
fields.subtitle: Small, disadvantaged, and certified firms get discovered by prime contractors fulfilling mandated diversity participation goals. Showcase your NAICS capabilities, respond to targeted RFQs, and post jobs to hire verified field labor.

fields.heading: Supported Federal & State Certifications
fields.intro: These designations qualify your firm for sole-source awards, set-aside solicitations, and prime contractor diversity spend mandates.

cards.title: Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE)
cards.body: Mandated participation goals across US DOT, highway, transit, airport, and federally-assisted infrastructure programs.

cards.title: Minority Business Enterprise (MBE)
cards.body: Recognized by state, municipal, and institutional procurement authorities for diversity spend tracking and set-aside awards.

cards.title: Women-Owned Business Enterprise (WBE / WOSB)
cards.body: Qualifies for federal WOSB/EDWOSB set-aside solicitations and state/local prime diversity participation goals.

cards.title: Historically Underutilized Business (HUB)
cards.body: Statewide procurement preference program with statutory good-faith subcontracting goals across state agency contracts.

cards.title: Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned (SDVOSB)
cards.body: Priority federal set-aside and sole-source eligibility across VA, DoD, and civilian agency infrastructure procurements.

cards.title: SBA 8(a) Business Development
cards.body: Premier nine-year federal program providing direct access to sole-source contracts and mentor-protégé joint ventures.

cards.title: Small Business Enterprise (SBE)
cards.body: Race- and gender-neutral small business designation prioritized on municipal, county, and regional transit procurements.

cards.title: African American Business Enterprise (AABE)
cards.body: Recognized by municipal and regional contracting authorities committed to equitable subcontracting utilization.

fields.heading: How the Business Portal Accelerates Contract Flow
fields.intro: From SAM.gov alignment to prime RFQ bidding and field crew recruitment.

steps.label: Register Company & UEI
steps.detail: Establish your corporate profile with entity structure, SAM.gov UEI, bonding capacity, six-digit NAICS codes, and active certifications.

steps.label: Complete Compliance Tracks
steps.detail: Follow guided checklists to obtain or renew DBE, MBE, HUB, WOSB, SDVOSB, or 8(a) designations for your target market.

steps.label: Generate Capability Statement
steps.detail: Instantly compile an executive, print-ready One-Page Capability Statement formatted to federal contracting officer standards.

steps.label: Respond to Primes & Hire Labor
steps.detail: Submit bids on prime contractor RFQs and post trade jobs to recruit verified workers directly from the EVOGovCon Labor Directory.

fields.heading: Built for Subcontractors Scaling in the Public Sector

cards.title: High-Intent Prime Discovery
cards.body: Prime estimators and diversity compliance officers search our verified business directory when assembling bid teams for government awards.

cards.title: Capability Statement Engine
cards.body: Generate a polished, procurement-standard capability statement directly from your profile data—ready for PDF export or prime review.

cards.title: NAICS Solicitation Matching
cards.body: Your six-digit NAICS codes automatically match your firm to active prime RFQs and public sector subcontracting opportunities.

cards.title: Integrated Labor Dispatch
cards.body: When you win a subcontract, post trade jobs directly to our skilled labor directory to staff OSHA- and CDL-verified field crews.

fields.heading: Position Your Firm in Front of Prime Contractors.
fields.text: Register your business free, generate your capability statement, and start receiving matched prime solicitations.
